supporting_observations.claim: The repeated failures are reported from FILE-COP-01, with workstation name FILE-COP-01 and source address 10.52.20.20; they recur at roughly one-minute intervals.
The failures repeatedly identify svc-routes and report status 0xc000006a; corresponding domain-controller validation records also show 0xc000006a or Kerberos pre-authentication status 0x18.

At 13:30, FILE-COP-01 recorded SYSTEM running PowerShell with explicit credentials for svc-routes against DC-COP-01. Together with the scheduled password rotation and recurring job described in the environment context, the later regular failures are consistent with the job continuing to use an outdated credential after rotation; the records do not prove that this was the cause.
